question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Do it on autopilot**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Do it on autopilot"** means to perform a task automatically or instinctively, often out of habit, without consciously thinking about it. (आदतन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After years of practice, he can play the piano on autopilot, barely paying attention to the keys.
 
 
• **Correct Explanation:** Option 3 ("Do it out of habit") accurately captures the meaning of "Do it on autopilot," as it refers to performing actions instinctively or routinely without active focus. (आदतन करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She was so used to her morning routine that she could complete it on autopilot.
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** Do it with full attention (पूरी ध्यान से करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He performed the surgery with full attention to ensure everything went smoothly.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** Do it while distracted (ध्यान भटकाने के दौरान करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She accidentally made mistakes while cooking because she was distracted by the TV.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** Do it with full enthusiasm (पूरे उत्साह के साथ करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The children decorated the Christmas tree with full enthusiasm.
 
 

37:T988,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
